protocol.intervals: whole annotated intervals >=15 seconds; no padding or invented labels
protocol.alignment: signal time = video annotation time - VIDEO_OFFSET; offset-sign assumption disclosed; sensitivity +offset also reported
protocol.quality: both modalities finite/nonflat, ADC clipping <=2%, >=8 RR, >=90% RR in 300..2000ms; no label-based signal rejection
protocol.model: StandardScaler fitted only on training subjects + LogisticRegression C=1, balanced class weights, max_iter=2000
protocol.evaluation: leave-one-participant-out; identical accepted intervals for EEG, cardiac and concatenated fusion; no tuning
limitations: Single EEG lead and no ICA/manual artifact adjudication
Ultra-short interval HRV is noisy and not clinical HRV
Offset sign is an explicit assumption, not independently verified from omitted videos
Overlapping intervals remain in the same subject fold; effective n is participants, not intervals

anger_vs_sadness.bootstrap_note: Percentile bootstrap of existing outer-fold predictions by subject; approximate uncertainty, not nested refit or multiplicity correction
anger_vs_sadness.confounding_audit: Game-ID-only negative control added before outer-fold scoring. Game/emotion association can make classification reflect task context or artifacts rather than emotion-specific physiology.
